name: Qodo
tagline: AI quality agents for code review, tests, and PRs
description: Qodo (formerly CodiumAI) focuses on code quality. Its agents generate meaningful unit tests, review pull requests, suggest refactors, and produce code-aware analyses. The Qodo Gen IDE plugin sits alongside completion tools; Qodo Merge automates PR review on GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket. Designed to complement rather than replace generic copilots.
pricingDetails: Developer: free. Teams: $19/user/month. Enterprise: custom with self-hosted option.
